divinitySource: public/divinity-manual/index.html, Code 81 Branch on Character Condition
runtimeContract: Require every character in the whole-party, nonempty picked set, or documented one-based party position to have the condition, then branch to the success or failure XAP with the authored GOSUB flag.
sourceQuirks: Castle directly indexes positive candidate modes even though Divinity labels one as the top character, permits an out-of-bounds sixth position, never reads the documented failure-message field, and treats an empty picked set as matched. Realmz 2.0 intentionally corrects the indexing and empty-set defects under FD-SCENARIO-004.
determinism: The operation consumes no RNG and reads only save-owned character conditions and selected identities.
